svg.title: watsonx.governance and Guardium AI Security in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM's figures: a free 14-day trial of watsonx.governance with included credits; a 30-day trial of the Model Management plan, then pay as you go; three frameworks IBM names for Guardium AI Security, the EU AI Act, NIST and ISO 42001, and more. Each figure is IBM's, from its watsonx.governance page and pricing page and its Guardium AI Security announcement. IBM states no test conditions for them.
